messages:
Alex R: Quick follow-up from the P99 outage — I think our postmortem follow-up process needs clearer timelines and owner SLAs. Proposing a short playbook: timeline template + comms cadence + explicit remediation owners + monthly IC rotation. Thoughts?

Maya P: +1. We keep losing sight of long tail actions (30/60/90). A template would help.

Sam K: Agree. Also flagging recurring pattern: cache-thundering shows up in 3 incidents in last quarter. We should tie recurring patterns into priority for remediation.

Jin W: Proposed timeline:
```
- Day 0-1: Incident summary + initial comms (IC)
- Day 2-7: Postmortem draft + RCA (owners assigned)
- Day 8-14: Action items triaged + owners + estimated ETA
- Day 30 / 60 / 90: Closure check-ins / status updates
```
We should require owner + owner-SLA for each action (e.g., 2 weeks for high, 60 days for infra medium).

Liz H: For comms cadence: incident start -> incident channel + status every 30m while active -> postmortem published within 72h -> weekly updates for open remediations until closed. Can we automate reminders? :robot_face:

OncallBot: reminder created: postmortem-draft-check in 48h for thread 1768123456.

Alex R: Automation would be great. Also want a simple tracking sheet for owners / due dates / current status + link to playbook. Sam, can you add recurring-pattern column?

Sam K: Yep. I'll spin up a tracker (sheet) and add columns: owner, priority, SLA, due_date, status, recurring_pattern. Link when ready.

Maya P: For IC rotation — monthly sounds fine. Suggest we publish a rotation calendar and fallback backups. Also add a "postmortem reviewer" role separate from IC to force quality checks.

Jin W: +1 on reviewer role. Also want a template snippet for action item format so people don't write vague things. Example: `owner: jin.w; action: implement circuit-breaker on model pool; due: 2026-05-14; priority: high; acceptance: perf regress < 5% and canary for 24h`

Liz H: Can we add a policy that any issue that appears 2x in 30 days or 3x in 90 days escalates to a recurring-problem path with required remediation plan in 30 days?

Alex R: I like that. Let's make escalation automatic in tracker and add a recurring-incident review on the monthly reliability sync.

Maya P: Action items from this thread:
- Sam: create tracker and include recurring_pattern column (due EOD Thu)
- Jin: draft timeline + action-item template (due Mon)
- Liz: automation checklist for reminders + propose Slack workflow (due next Wed)
- Alex: draft rotation calendar and reviewer role doc (due Fri)

Sam K: Assigned. Will post sheet link when ready.

OncallBot: Created recurring-remediation label for tracker and scheduled weekly reminders for open actions.

Alex R: Cool. Once we have templates + tracker I'll propose we pilot for two months and iterate. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
